answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock scarce collateral before it can act, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds. Like a cedar rooted firm against the tundra wind, a staked identity cannot be cheaply cloned, and a sybil swarm whose only output is the hollow echo of empty requests just burns its own deposit. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so honest work earns and fake armies bankrupt themselves before they can tilt consensus.
